plan.fixed_validation_set: unchanged last-experience validation set, reused for every audit measurement
measurements: immediately after recycling; unchanged value reused when no unit was reset
plan.information_flow: evaluator-only; no measurements returned to learner, replay, controller, or optimizer
plan.comparison: bitwise equality against every final model-state tensor in the original trusted checkpoint

interpretation: Within-step differences isolate the immediate reset effect on one fixed validation sample, conditional on the observed training trajectory.
They do not identify the effect of removing earlier resets, newborn gain, momentum, or consolidation over the whole training run.
The selected anomaly and audit window are post-hoc diagnostics. No hyperparameters, learning rules, or feedback paths were changed.
Wall time includes additional validation and concurrent GPU workloads; it is not a matched-compute measurement.
